confidence_notes: I ran three searches: one for the RBA rate and two for La Spezia prices. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 USD figure from the RBA exchange-rate page. Restaurant meal prices come from crowdsourced and aggregator pages (inexpensive meal about €14-15, lunch about €15, three-course dinner about €38 per person) and are moderately reliable. The beer figure is an aggregator estimate of about €5 for 0.5L draft. I found no direct La Spezia price for cappuccino, cocktail or wine by the glass. Cappuccino is based on typical Italian bar prices. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer and general Italian restaurant norms. I assumed about 1.16 USD per EUR for the conversion, which I did not look up. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a July peak-season window, not from live listings. They are the least certain anchors, and La Spezia sits below nearby Cinque Terre prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Ligurian port city, cheaper than the neighbouring Cinque Terre villages and Portofino. It is roughly comparable to Genoa or Livorno, with some summer tourism uplift as a Cinque Terre gateway.
